_comment: env-relay: GitHub-runner downloads a file (full internet here — the sandbox egress is an allowlist) and commits it to the SAME branch. Edit `source_url`/`out_dir`/`filename` and push this file to re-trigger. Secrets: never embed a secret here; this is plain transport for a data file.
note: Source options: Google Drive direct (`https://drive.google.com/uc?/drive.usercontent.google.com/download?id=...` — gdown handles the confirm token) or any direct HTTP/HTTPS. WeTransfer we.tl needs the Playwright fallback (server-side session, not P2P).
